---
title: "Affiliate disclosure"
---

Some links on this site, chiefly in the Reviews sections, are affiliate links. If you buy through one of them I may receive a small commission at no extra cost to you. This applies in particular to links to Amazon, where I participate in the Amazon Associates programme (and its regional equivalents). <!-- Adjust the programme list once enrolled; Amazon requires specific wording — check the current Operating Agreement. -->

Affiliate relationships never determine what I review or what I say about it. I review books and products I have used, I say so when I did not pay for them, and I write negative reviews when they are deserved.

Posts that contain affiliate links carry a short note at the top.
